verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Often they have distressed me from my youth—now let Israel say—

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Often they have distressed me from my youth—now let Israel say—

verses.text: Often they have distressed me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.

segments.text: Often they have distressed me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.text: Upon my back, the plowmen were plowing; they have made long their furrows.

segments.text: Upon my back, the plowmen were plowing; they have made long their furrows.

verses.text: YHWH the Righteous One, may He cut off the cords of the wicked!

segments.text: YHWH the Righteous One, may He cut off the cords of the wicked!

verses.text: May they be put to shame and turned back, all those hating Zion!

segments.text: May they be put to shame and turned back, all those hating Zion!

verses.text: May they be like grass on the rooftops that has withered before it can grow,

segments.text: May they be like grass on the rooftops that has withered before it can grow,

verses.text: unable to fill the hand of one reaping, or the bosom of one binding sheaves.

verses.text: And neither let those passing by say, “The blessing of YHWH [be] upon you⁺; we bless you⁺ in the name of YHWH!”
